title: 第7章 猎杀角鳄第8章 猎杀角鳄2
slug: 从哥布林开始骑马砍杀
content_zh:
第2天天微微亮，李秦武就起来检查中毒哥布林的状态。
他先打开士兵管理界面，看到兵力恢复成了4，受伤状态的中毒哥布林已经恢复健康。
现实中那家伙也是，被李秦武推醒后又蹦又跳，元气满满毫无中毒迹象。
相比起来，和他同一个狩猎队，吃了红毒果的30几个哥布林已经凉了，无一幸存。
李秦武对中毒哥布林说道：“从现在开始你叫哥布大，带我去你们摘毒果子的地方。”
4人偷偷溜出哥布林部落，没引起任何人的关注。
李秦武先在灌木中取了长矛，然后哥布大带路往部落西边去了。
走了没一会儿，李秦武把队伍叫停，从仓库拿出烤鱼让众人分食。
刚加入部队的耗材和哥布大面露惊奇，第1次见有哥布林能凭空取物，惊奇后他们的注意力又被烤鱼吸引了，疯狂啃咬手里的烤鱼。
“以后没我允许，你们不准乱吃东西，这是命令，谁不服从，我大逼兜管饱！”
李秦武威胁道。
他怕昨天食物中毒事件再次上演，别人死不死他不管，可自己的兵不能出问题，现在他身上一个第纳尔都没了，根本没法将部队招致满员，这要是还意外减员，他得哭死。
现在的主要任务是打怪赚第纳尔，如果今天不能打到野怪，没钱支付给部队，部队士气会快速下降，直至三人脱离队伍。
届时没了系统的束缚，三人可能把他的秘密说出去，他绝对不允许这事发生！
进食完毕，李秦武催促哥布大带路，众人很快到达昨天狩猎队采摘野果的地方。
“老大你看，那个红红的就是毒果！”
哥布大指着一株小灌木浑身颤抖，单是看到那红红的果子他就胃疼了。
李秦武看到那小灌木上挂着很多红色果子，这东西看上去和草莓似的，不过表面很光滑，而且非常红，红的有些妖异。
这么醒目的果实，却没有小动物啃食，可见毒性之强烈！
李秦武用宽大树叶做了个收纳盒，摘了满满一盒红毒果，接着他带人快速北上，来到昨天遭遇角鳄的地方。

他对哥布矛下令：“鱼篓怎么做还记得吗？让耗材和哥布大给你做帮手，立刻去做几个鱼篓，然后去河边抓鱼。”
哥布矛吓的汗毛都竖起来了。
“老……老大！河边有角鳄啊！我……我不敢靠近……”
李秦武冷冷的看着他，抬起右手呈逼兜状。
哥布矛见状当场来了个立正。
“老大！保证完成任务！”
然后哥布矛带着两个家伙去找制作鱼篓的材料。
三人走开后，李秦武先找枯枝烂叶生火，寻了两根平直木棍，用剩下两颗野猪獠牙制作了两根长矛。
等他用篝火把长矛上的树脂烤干后，哥布矛疯了一样跑回来，他手上提着一只刚抓的大鱼。
“干得好，吃点东西休息一下，等下开打别掉链子！”
李秦武接过活鱼，从仓库中拿出一个单位的烤鱼分给三人，三人一看又能吃烤鱼，芜湖一声开始吃吃吃，都没人注意到他最后那句话什么意思。
李秦武用指甲刨开鱼腹，把鱼内脏全掏出来，然后塞了一把红毒果到鱼腹内，并狠狠按压了一下，鱼腹内的红毒果全都压出了汁水。
剩下的红毒果还有很多，他用石头把一半红毒果砸成糊糊，把鱼的外部也都糊了一遍，接着他把四支矛尖也涂上红毒果糊糊。
完成这一切，三只哥布林也吃饱了，李秦武一人发了一根长矛，自己右手提着长矛，左手提着一根藤条，藤条上挂了毒鱼。
content_en:
It was slightly brighter the next day, and Li Qinwu got up to check the status of the poisoned goblin.
He first opened the soldier management interface and saw that the troop strength had returned to 4, and the injured poisoned goblin had recovered to health.
The same thing happened to that guy in reality. After being pushed awake by Li Qinwu, he jumped up and down, full of energy and no signs of poisoning.
In comparison, the 30 or so goblins in the same hunting team with him who had eaten the red poison fruit were already cold and none of them survived.
Li Qinwu said to the poisoned Goblin: "From now on, your name is Gobuda, and take me to the place where you pick poisonous fruits."
The four of them sneaked out of the goblin tribe without attracting anyone's attention.
Li Qinwu first took the spear from the bushes, and then Gobuda led the way to the west of the tribe.
After walking for a while, Li Qinwu stopped the team and took out grilled fish from the warehouse for everyone to share.
The consumables and Gobs who had just joined the army were surprised. It was the first time they saw a Goblin taking things out of thin air. After being surprised, their attention was attracted by the grilled fish, and they crazily gnawed on the grilled fish in their hands.
"In the future, you are not allowed to eat without my permission. This is an order. If anyone disobeys, I will force you to eat!"
Li Qinwu threatened.
He was afraid that yesterday's food poisoning incident would happen again. He didn't care whether others died or not, but his own soldiers couldn't have any problems. Now that he didn't have a single dinar on him, he couldn't bring the army to full strength. If there was an unexpected attrition, he would cry to death.
The main task now is to earn dinars from killing monsters. If you cannot kill wild monsters today and have no money to pay the troops, the morale of the troops will drop rapidly until the three of you leave the team.
By then, without the constraints of the system, the three of them might reveal his secret, and he would never allow this to happen!
After finishing eating, Li Qinwu urged Gobuda to lead the way, and everyone quickly arrived at the place where the hunting team picked wild fruits yesterday.
"Boss, look, that red one is the poisonous fruit!"
Gobuda pointed to a small shrub and trembled all over. Just seeing the red fruit made his stomach hurt.
Li Qinwu saw many red fruits hanging on the small shrub. They looked like strawberries, but the surface was very smooth and very red, which was a bit eerie.
Such an eye-catching fruit, but no small animals eat it, which shows how toxic it is!
Li Qinwu made a storage box out of broad leaves and picked a box full of red poisonous fruits. Then he led his people quickly north to the place where they encountered the horned crocodile yesterday.
He ordered Gob Spear: "Do you remember how to make fish baskets? Let the supplies and Gobuda help you, make a few fish baskets immediately, and then go to the river to catch fish."
Gob Spear was so frightened that his hair stood on end.
"Boss...Boss! There are horned crocodiles by the river! I...I dare not get close..."
Li Qinwu looked at him coldly and raised his right hand in a crotch shape.
When Gobu Mao saw this, he stood at attention on the spot.
"Boss! Make sure to complete the mission!"
Then Gobu Mao took two guys to find materials for making fish baskets.
After the three of them walked away, Li Qinwu first made a fire with dead branches and leaves, found two straight wooden sticks, and made two spears with the remaining two wild boar tusks.
After he used a campfire to dry the resin on the spear, Gob Spear ran back like crazy, holding a big fish he had just caught.
"Well done, have something to eat and rest, and don't let the fight begin later!"
Li Qinwu took the live fish and took out a unit of grilled fish from the warehouse and distributed it to three people. When the three of them saw that they could eat the grilled fish again, Wuhu started to eat, and no one noticed what his last sentence meant.
Li Qinwu used his nails to dig open the belly of the fish, took out all the fish's internal organs, then stuffed a handful of red poisonous fruits into the belly of the fish, and pressed it hard, all the juice was squeezed out of the red poisonous fruits in the fish's belly.
There were still a lot of red poison berries left, so he smashed half of the red poison berries into paste with a stone and smeared the outside of the fish. Then he coated the tips of the four spears with the red poison fruit paste.
After completing all this, the three goblins alsoAfter eating, Li Qinwu handed out a spear. He held the spear in his right hand and a rattan in his left hand, with poisonous fish hung on the rattan.
